## CRM → Ops follow-up handoff
Your CRM fires **Closed Won** → a Follow-up task lands in the Follow-ups sheet (with a due date) → WhatsApp/email to the deal's owner.
Every Monday 09:00 IST: the weekly follow-up review.
Rules live in one place: the Code nodes (source: handoff.js). Customize `fromCrm()` for your CRM's actual field names.

### Sample payload
Right now `send-test.sh` posts a generic CRM-shaped sample lead.
To go live: in your CRM (HubSpot, Pipedrive, GoHighLevel, Zoho, ...) create ONE webhook on the deal-closed event pointing here, with custom header `X-Handoff-Secret`. Capture one real payload and adjust `fromCrm()` only.

### WhatsApp + email
Email (Gmail) carries the demo. WhatsApp is wired and live; Meta refuses sends until the account has billing set up, so a failed WhatsApp never stops the email.
Production: swap for the WATI node (`n8n-nodes-wati` → Send Template Message) with an approved utility template.

### Alternative entry (off)
If webhooks aren't available from the CRM, poll its "recently updated deals" API every 15 min with its access keys. Map its output to the same fields before **Build Follow-up task**.
